job.job_title: Machine Learning Engineer ( RAG & Generative AI)
job.job_description:
Position: Machine Learning Engineer RAG & Generative AI

Job Type: Permanent

Notice Period: Immediate Joiner 

Experience: 5 - 10 Years 

Location: Pan India




Key Responsibilities

Develop, deploy, and maintain machine learning models for business applications.
Collaborate with data engineering, product, and cross-functional teams to deliver AI/ML solutions.
Analyze large datasets, perform feature engineering, and optimize model performance.
Build and support RAG-based and LLM-powered solutions for enterprise use cases.
Evaluate, test, and improve machine learning models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Document model development processes, workflows, and technical solutions.
Ensure compliance with organizational standards, security requirements, and best practices.

Required Skills

24 years of experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, or related fields.
Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-learn and TensorFlow.
Solid understanding of RAG concepts, including embeddings, chunking, retrieval, reranking, prompt engineering, and grounding.
Experience with vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, or pgvector.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Familiarity with data preprocessing, model evaluation, and performance optimization techniques.

Preferred Skills

Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Knowledge of healthcare, life sciences, or enterprise data domains.
Understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) applications.
